crossRefs.note: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst after righteousness, for they shall be filled.

translations.web: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
translations.bsb: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.
translations.kjv: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
translations.asv: But desire earnestly the greater gifts. And moreover a most excellent way show I unto you.
